# z47 tracked source ownership manifest
#
# Entries are repo-root paths. Keep every tracked top-level path classified in
# exactly one of the first two sections.
#
# The imported upstream tree is mounted at a single root (upstream/, per
# UPSTREAM_ROOT in upstream-pin.env) so that z47 owners can hold the canonical
# src/ and docs/ names.

[z47-owned]
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
COPYING
.gitattributes
.github
.gitignore
.gitmodules
.pre-commit-config.yaml
CONTRIBUTING.md
README.md
build.zig
build.zig.zon
pyproject.toml
build
docs
src

[imported-upstream]
upstream

[approved-z47-additions-under-imported]
# Paths z47 adds under the imported root, UPSTREAM-relative (the path upstream
# uses), not repo-relative. The check diffs the pin's tree against the imported
# tree, so an entry is needed only for a file the pin does not have. A file z47
# modifies belongs in imported-tree-divergences.txt [patched] instead. An entry
# no added path falls under is reported as unused.
